choice-justified:scroll-linked-explainer.why: Not chosen (router primary rejected). Router's top pick. Brian reviews plans as a page of diagrams he can scan and point at; a scroll-linked explainer hides the parts behind steps. Built a composite of five small views instead, each with the form its job needs: a node-link map for the durable set (relations between roles), a hub-and-spoke for the traceability chain, a directed flow with refusal loops for the lifecycle, identical small frames for plan sizing, a sequence for milestones (router alternative directed-handoff-flow), plus a callout box for disproof.
